drawer.note: Box width = opening width − 2 × side gap (at least {{minimum}} per side). Box height is a percentage of the space’s inner height, shared by all four walls. The bottom slots into a groove half a wall deep in each wall, raised by the recess to clear the slides. Front height is a percentage of the front’s full height, keeping its bottom edge. An inset front moves the box back by its thickness.
